newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse, Belfox, CIK plan merger.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse, Belfox, CIK plan merger.

text.p: The Brussels bourse, the Belgian futures and options exchange Belfox and securities clearing house CIK are planning a merger, the Belgian financial daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd said on Thursday,
The paper said the boards of the three institutions will meet this afternoon to discuss a possible merger later this year.
The merger will be patterned on the merger earlier this year of the bourse and derivatives exchange in Amsterdam, Netherlands.
